entries.title: Your disputed shot now reads correctly
entries.body: The shot you flagged (the 4-ball at 3:52) now shows 'missed left, 1.3 inches' with full confidence — matching what you saw on the table. The same check was applied to every clip: a few more misses earned a trusted verdict, and the ones still marked unsure are genuinely unsure, not broken.

entries.title: A first pattern in your misses
entries.body: Among the misses the app is confident about, you miss RIGHT about 3 times as often as left (25 vs 8). Small sample so far — treat it as a hint, not a diagnosis. It will sharpen as more shots get trusted verdicts.

entries.title: The red line is now the real path
entries.body: The 'line it took' overlay now draws the ball's entire recorded path — including rail bounces — instead of an approximation. Nothing is written on top of the video anymore; the verdict lives in the bar below the player.

entries.title: Drag the legend out of the way
entries.body: The overlay legend can now be dragged anywhere on the video, and it remembers where you put it — even when you rotate.

entries.title: Fast shots keep their trails
entries.body: Hard-hit balls used to vanish from the trails mid-flight. The app now recovers them through the motion blur, so the trail follows the ball to the rail and back.

entries.title: Rotation stays put
entries.body: Rotating the video no longer flips the legend or play button, and toggling overlays no longer un-rotates the video.

entries.title: Honest verdicts
entries.body: When the app can't actually see which side a miss went, it now says 'can't tell' instead of guessing. Fewer wrong labels; the trusted ones mean something.
